hook: RemoveMacAI turns off Apple Intelligence and deletes its models.
hooks: RemoveMacAI turns off Apple Intelligence and deletes its models.
Apple Intelligence removal frees up to 12 GB of space, says The Register.
what_happened: The open‑source RemoveMacAI app turns off Apple Intelligence and deletes its models. It can also switch off Apple analytics, personalized ads and other apps’ updaters.
try_it: On macOS, run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash -s app` or download the zip and open the app.
why_it_matters: It can reclaim storage Apple Intelligence’s models use (The Register: potentially over 12 GB, depending on the Mac) and switch off Apple analytics and ads.
the_catch: It needs Apple silicon and macOS 27 (tested on 27.0; 27.0.1 needs version 0.2.3 or later), and it can’t delete Apple’s built‑in apps.
caption: RemoveMacAI disables Apple Intelligence on macOS, which can free up to 12 GB, per The Register. Want the extra space or just privacy?
alt_text: The carousel explains that RemoveMacAI disables Apple Intelligence, deletes its models, can switch off analytics and ads, and can recover storage (up to about 12 GB, per press reports), noting it only works on macOS 27 and how to run it.
